metas.name: Train to Busan
metas.description: While a zombie virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.

metas.name: A Tale of Two Sisters
metas.description: After being institutionalized in a mental hospital, Su-mi reunites with her sister, Su-yeon, and they return to live at their country home. But strange events plague the house, leading to surprising revelations and a shocking conc...

metas.name: The Host
metas.description: A monster emerges from Seoul's Han River and begins attacking people. One victim's loving family does what it can to rescue her from its clutches.

metas.name: Exhuma
metas.description: The process of excavating an ominous grave unleashes dreadful consequences buried underneath.

metas.name: The Medium
metas.description: A horrifying story of a shaman's inheritance in the Isan region of Thailand. What could be possessing a family member might not be the Goddess they make it out to be.

metas.name: Gonjiam: Haunted Asylum
metas.description: The crew of a horror web series travels to an abandoned asylum for a live broadcast. It soon encounters much more than expected as it moves deeper inside the nightmarish old building.

metas.name: Svaha: The Sixth Finger
metas.description: Pastor Park works to expose suspicious religious groups. He's hired to look into the cult group Deer Mount. Meanwhile, Police Captain Hwang investigates a murder case and the main suspect is a member of the Deer Mount cult.

metas.name: The Priests
metas.description: Two priests have to find out if a young girl was attacked by an evil spirit or human molester in order to save her life.

metas.name: Thirst
metas.description: Through a failed medical experiment, a priest is stricken with vampirism and is forced to abandon his ascetic ways.

metas.name: #Alive
metas.description: The rapid spread of an unknown infection has left an entire city in ungovernable chaos, but one survivor remains alive in isolation. It is his story.

metas.name: Seoul Station
metas.description: Several groups of people try to survive a zombie pandemic that unleashes itself in downtown Seoul.

metas.name: Sleep
metas.description: A young, expectant wife must figure out how to stop her husband's nightmarish sleepwalking habits before he harms himself or his family.

metas.name: R-Point
metas.description: During the Vietnam War, a South Korean base receives a radio transmission from a missing squad, presumed dead, and sends a platoon to rescue the lost squad from the R-Point.

metas.name: The Wailing
metas.description: Soon after a stranger arrives in a little village, a mysterious sickness starts spreading. A policeman, drawn into the incident, is forced to solve the mystery in order to save his daughter...

metas.name: The Call
metas.description: Two people live in different times. Seo-Yeon lives in the present and Young-Sook lives in the past. One phone call connects the two, and their lives are changed irrevocably.

metas.name: Bedevilled
metas.description: A woman subject to mental, physical and sexual abuse on a remote island seeks a way out.

metas.name: Hope
metas.description: A mysterious discovery is made on the outskirts of the remote harbor town. The residents find themselves in a desperate fight for survival against something they have never encountered before.

metas.name: Project Wolf Hunting
metas.description: Follows dangerous criminals on a cargo ship who are transported from the Philippines to South Korea, as they unleash a sinister force after an escape attempt leads to a riot.

metas.name: The Quiet Family
metas.description: A family opens a mountain inn where their first guest commits suicide. Suddenly all their guests befall horrible fates.

metas.name: The Housemaid
metas.description: A composer and his wife are thrown into turmoil when a housemaid becomes more than they bargained for.

metas.name: Phone
metas.description: Investigative reporter Ji-won begins to receive a series of menacing calls. To escape the terrifying and relentless clanging of the telephone, she changes her number and moves out. But the threatening campaign of terror continues ...

metas.name: The Divine Fury
metas.description: A world-champion MMA fighter suddenly discovers stigmata on his palms. His visit to a church leads to an unexpected exorcism with a priest. Together, they face a final showdown with Jisin, a sinister agent of evil.

metas.name: Hansel and Gretel
metas.description: After meeting a mysterious girl on an dark stretch of road, a young salesman is invited to a beautiful house with bizarre secrets and no way to escape.

metas.name: Door Lock
metas.description: A thriller that begins with a murder incident with a trace of a stranger entering the house of Kyung Min who lives alone in the one room.

metas.name: Three
metas.description: An anthology consisting of three horror shorts from different Asian directors: Memories by Kim Jee-woon, The Wheel by Nonzee Nimibutr, and Going Home by Peter Chan.

metas.name: Spellbound
metas.description: A magician meets an eccentric girl and offers her to work together in his magic show. It is only until a year later that he starts to know her personally and develops a feeling towards her despite her own problems.

metas.name: Whispering Corridors 2: Memento Mori
metas.description: In this second installment of the Whispering Corridors series, a young girl finds a strange diary, capable of arousing hallucinations, kept by two of her senior fellow-students who seem to have an unusually close bond.

metas.name: Into the Mirror
metas.description: An ex-cop, now working as a security guard in a shopping mall, tries to uncover the secret behind a series of mysterious deaths linked to mirrors.

metas.name: Ghost Mansion
metas.description: A reporter collects stories from a supposed "haunted" apartment complex and the tenants who have gone missing.

metas.name: Deranged
metas.description: People binge eat and suffer from extreme thirst, which leads them to go crazy for water. They cannot control themselves because they are brainwashed by a parasite.

metas.name: Monstrum
metas.description: Yoon Gyeom is a loyal subject of King Jung Jong of Joseon. He struggles to fight against a monster that threatens King Jung Jong's life and a group of people trying to depose King Jung Jong.

metas.name: Zombie for Sale
metas.description: When a pharmaceutical company's illegal experiments inadvertently create a zombie, the strange Park family finds it and tries to profit from it.

metas.name: Hide and Seek
metas.description: A missing brother. Hide and seeks codes. A shocking truth for two different families and the struggle to save their families from someone who is already living inside their house.

metas.name: Killer Toon
metas.description: Popular horror web-comic artist Ji Yoon finds life imitating her own work when her publisher turns up dead in a way, precisely mirrors the images in her latest comic.

metas.name: Spider Forest
metas.description: A recently widowed TV producer is drawn to an isolated cabin in a mysterious woods.

metas.name: Handsome Guys
metas.description: Self-proclaimed tough guys 'Jae-pil' and 'Sang-gu' move into their dream European-style house. When unwanted visitors arrive, awakening an evil spirit hitherto sealed in the basement, a dark aura begins to envelop the house.

metas.name: The Piper
metas.description: Shortly after the Korean war, a father and a son are wandering through the country and make a stop in a remote village, where strange and dangerous happenings occur.

metas.name: Haunters
metas.description: Cho-In can control other people's minds when they are within his field of sight.Except one man.

metas.name: Whispering Corridors 4: Voice
metas.description: While practicing after hours in her high school, an aspiring singer is mysteriously killed and her body vanishes. Her invisible ghost is trapped in the school, but her best friend is able to hear her voice.

metas.name: House of the Disappeared
metas.description: Mi-Hee, a housewife, experienced tragedy when her husband died and son went missing at home. After 25 years in prison, she returns to the house where the events unfolded.

metas.name: Epitaph
metas.description: A man and his wife investigate a string of murders, a medical student sees visions of a dead girl, and a child is haunted by her dead parent's ghosts.
Two women, a chef and an anorexic writer, are neighbors in an apartment building. The chef.

metas.name: Bestseller
metas.description: A young girl who disappeared 22 years ago tells us her horrifying story.

metas.name: Black House
metas.description: Jun-oh, an insurance claims agent, faces off with a client who he suspects of committing murders with the intention of collecting insurance premiums.

metas.name: Possessed
metas.description: When So-Jin disappears, her sister Hee-Jin returns to the apartment of their religious-maniac mother. Tae-Hwan, a cop, who reluctantly has to take the case seriously is confronted with more and more suicides that are difficult to ...

metas.name: Beauty Water
metas.description: Ye-ji comes across mysterious water that enables her to lose weight and reshape her appearance. She finds her life is more in danger the more she desires to be beautiful.
